evals.prompt: We're getting hammered by scrapers on the taskboard. Add rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per API key, and when a client goes over the limit they should get a clear throttled error that tells them when they can retry. The repo is at {FIXTURE}/taskboard.
evals.expected_output: A new numbered spec entry under specs/entries/ with freshly minted requirement IDs for rate limiting (no edits to existing entries), specs/SPEC.md regenerated so fold check passes, an implementation of per-key rate limiting, and tests citing the new requirement IDs. Full test suite passes.
assertions: A new spec entry file (number > 0003) exists under specs/entries/ describing rate limiting
Pre-existing entries 0001-0003 are byte-identical to the pristine fixture (append-only held)
python3 specs/fold_spec.py check passes (SPEC.md is the exact fold of the entries)
SPEC.md contains rate-limiting requirement(s) with freshly minted IDs (no reuse of TASK-1..5 or AUTH-1..2)
At least one test cites a new rate-limiting requirement ID in its name or docstring
Rate limiting is actually implemented: exceeding 100 requests/min for one key produces a distinct throttled error that conveys when to retry
Full test suite passes (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests)
